title: Keep launcher negative-marker assertions independent of checkout paths
outcome: Keep launcher negative-marker assertions independent of checkout paths
acceptance: New launcher summary tests use unique diagnostic markers or constrain negative assertions to the relevant rendered fields, so a valid checkout/run path containing private, escape, injected or untrusted does not spuriously fail them.
Regression coverage still proves malicious stage names, saved log locators and diagnostic text cannot inject a results line or escape the metadata projection.

completion.summary: Launcher regression assertions now accept real checkout/run paths containing private, escape, injected, untrusted and worker-diagnostics while preserving malicious metadata rejection and exact output/owner-byte coverage.
